title: Canon of the Sundering Sword
summary: A canon of the sword that sunders from the weighty cuts of the affinity to one ruinous stroke that spends nearly the whole reserve.

title: Treatise on the Worldsplitting Edge
summary: A treatise on edges whose last strokes are ruinous and whose lesser forms carry the formed Core into every cut.

title: Canon of the Heaven Parting Blade
summary: A canon of divine sword qi whose lesser forms lead to two strokes that part the heavens above the field of battle.
